recruitment: Indian Army Agniveer (General Duty), Agnipath scheme. Physical Fitness Test as printed in Army Recruiting Office notifications (recruiting year 2027, published 13-02-2026)

owner_review.note: Read by Claude from three official ARO notification PDFs that carry the same table (2022, 2025-26, 2027). Arpit to confirm against the PDF. Physical Measurement Test (height, chest, weight) is region based and is NOT included: the notices I could read are for the Southern and Dehradun regions, and joinindianarmy.nic.in sits behind a captcha.

notes: Physical Fitness Test (para 24.1 of the 2027 notice): 1.6 km run in groups, Group I up to 5 min 30 s = 60 marks, Group II 5:31 to 5:45 = 48, Group III 5:46 to 6:00 = 36, Group IV 6:01 to 6:15 = 24. Pull-ups on the beam: 10 or more = 40 marks, 9 = 33, 8 = 27, 7 = 21, 6 = 16. The 9 ft ditch and the zig-zag balance carry no marks: 'need to qualify'.

The run limit stored here is 6:15, the slowest time for which the notice awards any marks. The notice does not say in words that a slower run is a fail, so treat 6:15 as the cut-off for marks, and aim for 5:30 for full marks. Likewise 6 pull-ups is the lowest count that earns marks.
The notice says the timings and marks 'can be changed by the Indian Army at any stage before the recruitment rally' and asks candidates to check joinindianarmy.nic.in before the rally.
Agniveer Technical and Agniveer Clerk/Store Keeper Technical only need to qualify in all tests, without marks (para 24.1 note 2).
The 1.6 km run may be held on road or hard surface because of weather (para 26.14).

Physical Measurement Test (para 24.2): height, chest and weight follow 'Region based and Category wise Physical standards'. Not modelled here. Agniveer Women (Military Police) have a separate notice, also not modelled.
